declarations.name: PHLivePhoto.Representation
declarations.comment:
The type of the representation used to import and export the item.

Swift infers this type from the return value of the
``transferRepresentation`` property.

declarations.name: PhotosPicker
declarations.comment:
A control that allows a user to choose photos and/or videos from the photo library.

The user explicitly grants access only to items they choose, so photo library access authorization is not needed.

declarations.name: PhotosPickerItem
declarations.comment:
An item that can be provided to or provided by the Photos picker.

An item can contain multiple representations. Each representation has a corresponding content type.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates an item without any representation using an identifier.

- Parameters:
    - itemIdentifier: The local identifier of the item.

members.name: itemIdentifier
members.comment: The local identifier of the item. It will be `nil` if the Photos picker is created without a photo library.

members.name: supportedContentTypes
members.comment: All supported content types of the item, in order of most preferred to least preferred.

declarations.name: PhotosPickerItem.EncodingDisambiguationPolicy
declarations.comment: A policy that decides the encoding to use given a content type, if multiple encodings are available.

members.name: compatible
members.comment: Uses the most compatible encoding if possible, even if transcoding is required.

members.name: current
members.comment: Uses the current encoding to avoid transcoding if possible.

members.name: automatic
members.comment: Uses the best encoding determined by the system. This may change in future releases.

declarations.name: PhotosPickerSelectionBehavior
declarations.comment: A value that determines how the Photos picker handles user selection.

members.name: continuousAndOrdered
members.comment: Selection can be delivered continuously and uses the selection order made by the user. Selected assets are numbered.

members.name: ordered
members.comment: Uses the selection order made by the user. Selected items are numbered.

declarations.name: PhotosPickerStyle
declarations.comment: A value that determines the style of the Photos picker.

members.name: compact
members.comment: Inline and compact picker mode (single row).

globals.signature: nonisolated init(_ titleKey: LocalizedStringKey, selection: Binding<[PhotosPickerItem]>, maxSelectionCount: Int? = nil, selectionBehavior: PhotosPickerSelectionBehavior = .default, matching filter: PHPickerFilter? = nil, preferredItemEncoding: PhotosPickerItem.EncodingDisambiguationPolicy = .automatic, photoLibrary: PHPhotoLibrary)
globals.comment:
Creates a Photos picker with its label generated from a localized string key that selects a collection of `PhotosPickerItem` from a given photo library.

The user explicitly grants access only to items they choose, so photo library access authorization is not needed.

- Parameters:
    - titleKey: A localized string key that describes the purpose of showing the picker.
    - selection: All items being shown and selected in the Photos picker.
    - maxSelectionCount: The maximum number of items that can be selected. Default is `nil`. Setting it to `nil` means maximum supported by the system.
    - selectionBehavior: The selection behavior of the Photos picker. Default is `.default`.
    - filter: Types of items that can be shown. Default is `nil`. Setting it to `nil` means all supported types can be shown.
    - preferredItemEncoding: The encoding disambiguation policy of selected items. Default is `.automatic`. Setting it to `.automatic` means the best encoding determined by the system will be used.
    - photoLibrary: The photo library to choose from.
